item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 reporting proving Jokowi personally received bribes, gifts, hidden assets, or payments through opaque foundations. The evidence is strongest on family advantage, patronage, and insider access around office, not on a documented personal cash-taking scheme. So the safest reading is: substantial conflict-of-interest risk and family-linked benefit, but no clean proof of direct personal enrichment from office in the sources I found.","evidence":[{"title":"Indonesia’s anti-graft body plans to query president’s son about private jet trip","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-08-28","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/indonesias-antigraft-body-plans-to-query-presidents-son-about-private-jet-trip-3590725","summary":"The KPK said Kaesang’s private jet trip could amount to an improper gift if it was linked to his father’s office; Reuters also noted public anger and the broader dynasty context.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3"]},{"title":"Indonesian president’s son visits anti-graft body over private jet use","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-09-17","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/indonesian-presidents-son-visits-anti-111801430.html","summary":"Kaesang went to the anti-graft agency to clarify private jet use and denied misconduct, but the episode itself shows why the public saw possible office-adjacent benefit as plausible.","question_ids":["7B.4"]},{"title":"Indonesia leader accused of bias, interference in presidential election","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-02-01","url":"https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-leader-accused-of-bias-interference-in-presidential-election/1948656/","summary":"Reuters reported criticism that Jokowi’s public alignment with Prabowo while his son was on the ticket looked like incumbent power being converted into family political advantage.","question_ids":["7B.4","4B.2"]},{"title":"Indonesia’s outgoing leader gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-08-19","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/outgoing-indonesian-president-widodo-names-prabowo-aides-to-cabinet-3576652","summary":"Jokowi appointed ministers and agency heads close to Prabowo in a transition-smoothing move widely read as quid-pro-quo politics that preserved influence after office.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3"]},{"title":"Jokowi seeks major party takeover to retain decade-long influence","publisher":"Reuters via Yahoo News","date":"2024-03-21","url":"https://www.yahoo.com/news/analysis-indonesias-jokowi-seeks-major-100704619.html","summary":"Reuters said Jokowi was trying to install an ally at Golkar and secure an advisory role, which is classic office-to-network leverage rather than a clean separation from personal political benefit.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3"]},{"title":"World Bank Group Debars PT. LPPSLH Konsultan","publisher":"World Bank","date":"2024-07-10","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan","summary":"The Bank said an Indonesia nutrition project involved overbilling and the improper hiring of a project official’s family member. This is the clearest concrete 2024 evidence of favoritism/corrupt procurement in a Jokowi-era public project.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3"]},{"title":"Analysis-A decade of Jokowi: Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-10-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/","summary":"Reuters’ end-of-term analysis described patronage and dynastic politics as a defining feature of the decade, which is broad but relevant background for office-derived advantage.","question_ids":["7B.4","7B.3","4B.2"]},{"title":"Farewell-Welcome Ceremony for Indonesia’s President from Jokowi to Prabowo Subianto","publisher":"Sekretariat Kabinet Republik Indonesia","date":"2024-10-20","url":"https://setkab.go.id/en/farewell-welcome-ceremony-for-indonesias-president-from-jokowi-to-prabowo-subianto/","summary":"Jokowi completed the scheduled constitutional handover on inauguration day, which is some evidence against overt clinging to office for personal gain.","question_ids":["7B.4","4B.2"]},{"title":"Indonesia court rejects election challenges, upholds Prabowo’s win","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-04-22","url":"https://theprint.in/world/indonesia-court-rejects-election-challenges-upholds-president-elect-prabowos-win/2051948/","summary":"The court said there was no evidence of systematic fraud or presidential meddling. This is limited positive evidence that the formal transition was not visibly hijacked for direct personal enrichment.","question_ids":["7B.4","4B.2"]},{"title":"Indonesia’s President Joko Widodo insists ‘no problem’ in cabinet amid rumbles of discontent","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-02-02","url":"https://theprint.in/world/indonesias-jokowi-insists-no-problem-in-cabinet-amid-rumbles-of-discontent/1950219/","summary":"Jokowi publicly denied cabinet dysfunction and framed differences as normal; this is weak mitigating evidence only, but it does not show a proven financial conflict.","question_ids":["7B.4"]},{"title":"IMF staff completes 2024 Article IV mission to Indonesia","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-06-14","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/14/pr24221-imf-staff-completes-2024-article-iv-mission-to-indonesia","summary":"IMF described prudent, credible fiscal/monetary frameworks, which is indirect evidence that core macro institutions were still functioning in a technocratic mode rather than being visibly used for private enrichment.","question_ids":["7B.4"]}]}
